T: Tots in the pocket. Lunch sorted.
D: An awkward Idaho teen helps his friend Pedro run for class president.
P: Serve the tater tots when Napoleon pulls some out of his pocket in class.
S: Homemade grated potato tots fried until crisp
Grate parboiled potatoes, squeeze dry, season with salt and onion powder, shape into little cylinders, freeze 30 minutes, fry at 180C until golden and crisp.
Crisp potato skins with cheddar and bacon, sour cream and chives
Bake small potatoes, halve and scoop, brush with butter, crisp at 220C, fill with cheddar and bacon, bake again, sour cream and chives.
M: Flour tortillas with cheddar and Monterey Jack, pan crisped, salsa and sour cream
Flour tortillas filled with grated cheddar and Monterey Jack, folded, cooked in a dry pan over medium heat until golden and melted. Salsa and sour cream.
Uncle Rico's rump steak and corn
the steak Rico throws at Napoleon from the van

Rump steak seared hard in a smoking pan, rested and sliced, with corn on the cob in paprika butter and a pile of crispy smashed potatoes. Season 4 rump steaks (about 220g each) with salt and pepper 30 minutes ahead. Boil 800g baby potatoes until tender, smash flat on an oiled tray and roast at 220C for 25 minutes. Boil 4 corn cobs for 6 minutes and roll in 50g butter mixed with 1 tsp paprika. Sear the steaks in a smoking hot pan with 1 tbsp oil for 3 minutes a side for medium rare, rest 5 minutes, slice and serve with the corn and potatoes.
W: Hollowed butter cake filled with candy, covered in bright buttercream stripes
Vanilla cake baked in a dome with a hollow centre filled with lollies, covered in bright buttercream stripes so it spills when cut.
K: FFA blue ribbon chocolate malt shake
Chocolate ice cream and malt blended with milk, topped with cream and dark chocolate

Cold full cream milk blended thick with chocolate ice cream, malted milk powder and a pinch of salt, topped with whipped cream and chocolate shavings. Put 600ml cold full cream milk, 6 scoops chocolate ice cream, 4 tbsp malted milk powder and a pinch of salt in a blender. Blend for 30 seconds until thick and smooth. Pour into 4 chilled tall glasses. Whip 150ml thickened cream to soft peaks, spoon on top and grate 20g dark chocolate over each.

dishes.make_ahead: Shape and freeze up to 1 day ahead

steps.text: Parboil the whole potatoes, then cool.
Grate, squeeze dry and season with salt and onion powder.
Shape into little cylinders and freeze.
Fry in the vegetable oil at 180C in batches until golden and crisp all over.

dishes.make_ahead: Bake and scoop the potatoes up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; crisp, fill and top just before serving

steps.text: Bake the potatoes at 200C until tender.
Halve and scoop out most of the flesh. Cook the bacon until crisp and crumble.
Brush with butter and crisp at 220C.
Fill with cheddar and bacon and bake until melted.
Top with sour cream and chives.

veg.make_ahead: Bake the potatoes and fry the smoked tofu up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; crisp, fill and top on the night

steps.text: Bake the potatoes at 200C until tender.
Halve and scoop out most of the flesh. Fry the smoked tofu in the oil until crisp and golden.
Brush the skins with butter and crisp at 220C.
Fill with cheddar and smoked tofu and bake until melted.
Top with sour cream and chopped chives.

dishes.make_ahead: Grate the cheeses and dice the tomatoes up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; cook the quesadillas just before serving

steps.text: Fill the tortillas with the grated cheddar and Monterey Jack and fold in half.
Cook in a dry pan over medium heat until golden and melted, turning once.
Serve with diced tomato salsa and sour cream.
Heat the oven to 170C and grease an ovenproof bowl. Beat half the butter with the sugar, then the eggs.
Fold in the flour and milk, pour into the bowl and bake.
Cool completely.
Hollow out the centre and fill with the lollies.
Beat the remaining butter with the icing sugar, split it into portions and tint each with a different food colouring, then cover the cake in bright stripes.

dishes.n: FFA blue ribbon chocolate malt shake
dishes.make_ahead: Chill the glasses and grate the chocolate up to 1 day ahead; blend just before serving so the shake stays thick

steps.text: Chill four tall glasses.
Blend the milk, ice cream, malt powder and salt until thick and smooth.
Whip the cream to soft peaks.
Pour into the glasses, spoon on cream and grate chocolate over each.

Idaho potato skins.veg: Crisp potato skins with cheddar and smoked tofu, sour cream and chives

s.note: Homemade grated potato tots fried until crisp
s.how: Parboil 800g potatoes for 8 minutes, cool and grate. Squeeze dry and season with salt and 1 tsp onion powder. Shape into little cylinders and freeze 30 minutes. Fry at 180C until golden and crisp all over.

s.note: Crisp potato skins with cheddar and bacon, sour cream and chives
s.how: Bake 8 small potatoes at 200C for 45 minutes, halve and scoop out most of the flesh. Brush with 30g melted butter and crisp at 220C for 10 minutes. Fill with 150g grated cheddar and 4 rashers crisp bacon, bake 5 minutes more, top with sour cream and chives.

m.note: Flour tortillas with cheddar and Monterey Jack, pan crisped, salsa and sour cream
m.how: Fill 8 flour tortillas with 150g grated cheddar and 150g Monterey Jack, then fold in half. Cook in a dry pan over medium heat for 3 minutes a side until golden and melted. Serve with diced tomato salsa and sour cream.

w.note: Hollowed butter cake filled with candy, covered in bright buttercream stripes
w.how: Beat 200g butter and 200g sugar, add 4 eggs and fold in 250g self-raising flour and 100ml milk. Bake in an ovenproof bowl at 170C for 50 minutes. Hollow the centre, fill with 200g lollies and cover with 400g icing sugar beaten with 250g butter in bright stripes.

d.n: FFA blue ribbon chocolate malt shake
d.note: Chocolate ice cream and malt blended with milk, topped with cream and dark chocolate
d.how: Put 600ml cold full cream milk, 6 scoops chocolate ice cream, 4 tbsp malted milk powder and a pinch of salt in a blender. Blend for 30 seconds until thick and smooth. Pour into 4 chilled tall glasses. Whip 150ml thickened cream to soft peaks, spoon on top and grate 20g dark chocolate over each.
